subject: Flower bed
text: A Grilled Newt is hidden in the left flower bed in Frederia.

evidence.quote: There's Grilled Newt in the flower bed on the left, and a Miracle in the right one.

subject: Flower bed
text: A Miracle is hidden in the right flower bed in Frederia.

evidence.quote: There's Grilled Newt in the flower bed on the left, and a Miracle in the right one.

subject: Shaia Lab 4 basement cabinets
text: A Revive is found in the cabinets inside the basement of Shaia Lab 4.

evidence.quote: Shaia Lab 4, and then enter the basement. Check for a much-need Revive, and then a Stone Cure in the cabinents.

subject: Shaia Lab 4 basement cabinets
text: A Stone Cure is found in the cabinets inside the basement of Shaia Lab 4.

evidence.quote: Shaia Lab 4, and then enter the basement. Check for a much-need Revive, and then a Stone Cure in the cabinents.

subject: Falcon
text: Talking to Raile gives the final upgrades to the ship, granting the ability to fly across the world map without monster attacks.

evidence.quote: Talk to Raile, and you'll get your final fixin's on the ship. YES! Now, you can finally travel the world map WITHOUT BEING ATTACKED BY MONSTERS!...Using your newfound FLYING ABILITY, you can now sail towards Epro

subject: Arubus Weapon Shop
text: The Arubus weapon shop sells the Zircon Axe for Aguro and the Zircon Rod for Jerin.

evidence.quote: At the weapons shop, buy a Zircon Axe for Aguro and Zircon Rod for Jerin.

subject: Arubus Armor Shop
text: The Arubus armor shop stocks Zircon Armors, Zircon Robes, Zircon Plates, Zircon Helms, and Zircon Berets.

evidence.quote: Buy two Zircon Armors, a Zircon Robe, two Zircon Plates, two Zircon Helms, and then a Zircon Beret.

subject: Basement old man
text: The old man in the Arubus basement talks about plum cider but sells Apple Cider instead.

evidence.quote: In the back room, the old man tells you about his great 'plum cider'. Errr. . .what he sells you instead is Apple Cider.

subject: Dragon
text: Players can cash in a collected set of eight Dragon Eggs at the Dragon Shrine west of Herat.

evidence.quote: Go up to the dragon and cash in the set of Dragon Eggs you've found so far.

subject: Dragon's Wish
text: The dragon's first wish choice increases the entire party by 2 levels.

evidence.quote: Your first choice is 2 levels for everyone.

subject: Dragon's Wish
text: The dragon's second wish choice awards three of each stat-boosting potion.

evidence.quote: The second is three of each '~ Potion'. What he means by that are the Great Potions, Power Potions, etc.

subject: Dragon's Wish
text: Might Bows and Might Armors are exclusive items available from the dragon's wishes that cannot be found elsewhere.

evidence.quote: the next two choices, Might Bows and Might Armors, items you can't find anywhere else in the game. The first time, I took a Might Bow for Jerin.

subject: Might Bow
text: The Might Bow is ten points weaker than the Zircon Rod, but enables Jerin to attack all enemies at once.

evidence.quote: While it's ten points weaker than the Zircon Rod, it allows Jerin to attack all enemies, which outdoes the Zircon Rod's coolness factor.

subject: Treasure room chest
text: In the second set, a Dragon Egg is found on the first floor of Alekia in the secret treasure room where the Revive was located.

evidence.quote: The Dragon Egg there is in the 'secret' treasure room on the first floor, in the chest where the Revive was.

subject: Back cave chest
text: In the second set, a Dragon Egg is located in the back cave of Belgen.

evidence.quote: Next, warp to Belgen. The egg there is in the back cave.

subject: Top floor chest
text: In the second set, a Dragon Egg is found on the top floor of the Northwest Tower behind the man's room in a pair of chests.

evidence.quote: Fly to the Northwest Tower, the tower by Grenoble and the Old Cave. The Dragon Egg is on the top floor, behind the man's room in a group of two chests.

subject: Middle staircase chest
text: In the second set, a Dragon Egg is found down the middle staircase of the first room in the Southwest Cave in a pair of chests.

evidence.quote: head to the Southwest Cave, the cave southwest of Belgen. The Dragon Egg is down the middle staircase of the first room, and then up in a group of two chests

subject: Cave chest
text: In the second set, a Dragon Egg appears inside the single treasure chest in Marse Cave.

evidence.quote: The fifth Dragon Egg is in the Marse Cave's only treasure chest. (Remember that cave south of Linze, with only a Power Potion in it?)

subject: Lower left corner chest
text: In the second set, a Dragon Egg is found in Elba Cave down all the ladders in the bottom-left corner.

evidence.quote: The sixth egg is in Elba Cave, down all the ladders in the lowest left corner.

subject: Left cave north exit chest
text: In the second set, a Dragon Egg is in the Underwater Cave near the north exit of the left cave where the Ex Potion and Spell Potion chests were.

evidence.quote: The seventh egg of the 2nd set is by far the most annoying, it being buried beneath the sea in the Underwater Cave by Soshette. It's near the north exit of the left cave, by the pair of boxes the Ex Potion and Spell Potion were in.

subject: Second floor chest
text: In the second set, the last Dragon Egg is on the second floor of Epro Cave where the Ex Bomb chest was located.

evidence.quote: The last egg is in the Epro Cave. It's on the second floor, where you got the Ex Bomb.

subject: Gorgon
text: Gorgons in Arubus Cave use their petrification skill Iron Air over 75% of the time.

evidence.quote: Gorgons, monsters even WORSE (and in more abundance) than the golems. With their skill Iron Air, which they use over 75% of the time, they can easily turn your characters to stone.

subject: Barient
text: Barients in Arubus Cave randomly drop the Might Helmet.

evidence.quote: The Barients in here randomly drop Might Helmets, the ultimate helmets for your warriors.

subject: Cave chest
text: A Hi Potion is found upon entering Arubus Cave before returning up to the first level.

evidence.quote: Enter the cave, and follow along, taking the Hi Potion, and go back up to the first level.

subject: First floor chest
text: A Hi Bomb is found to the left after descending the right ladder on the first floor of Arubus Cave.

evidence.quote: Head down the right ladder, and take the Hi Bomb over to the left.

subject: First floor chest
text: A Gloom Arrow and a Smoke Ball are found towards the lower right corner on the first floor of Arubus Cave.

evidence.quote: Go straight down, take the Gloom Arrow, and then down to the right corner for a Smoke Ball.

subject: Lower right corner chest
text: A Magic Guard is found in the lower right corner of the first floor in Arubus Cave.

evidence.quote: In the lower right corner is a Magic Guard.

subject: First floor chest
text: A Mystery Pin is directly below the right ladder, and heading north leads to a Great Potion.

evidence.quote: take the Mystery Pin directly below you, and then head all the way north to get a Great Potion.

subject: First floor south chest
text: A Zircon Sword is located all the way south on the first floor of Arubus Cave.

evidence.quote: All the way south is a Zircon Sword.

subject: First floor middle room chest
text: A door near the middle of the first floor in Arubus Cave leads to a White Ring.

evidence.quote: A bit in the middle, you'll find a door, containing a White Ring.

subject: Second floor right room portal chest
text: Entering the right room on the second floor and using the portal at the end leads to a Mind Potion.

evidence.quote: On the second floor, enter the right room and take the portal at the end to get a Mind Potion.

subject: Second floor left room chests
text: The left room on the second floor of Arubus Cave contains three Miracles across its lower left sections.

evidence.quote: In the left room, follow the ladders and take the Miracle. There's another Miracle on the lower left side, and a third on the lower lower left side.

subject: Lake island chest
text: A Spell Potion is on the small lake island before taking the stairs down to the third floor.

evidence.quote: Take the Spell Potion and head down to the third floor, where you'll get the final three treasures in this cave.

subject: Glasadar Key
text: The Glasadar Key found in Arubus Cave unlocks Glasadar Tower and the fourth warp shrine connecting to Alekia.

evidence.quote: The Glasadar Key does two things, one being unlocking the Glasadar Tower, and the other unlocks the fourth warp shrine, which creates a full curcuit from the Tower of Grief to Alekia.

subject: First floor ladder chests
text: An Ex Bomb and Ex Arrows are found upon descending the ladders in Glasadar Cave.

evidence.quote: Descend the ladders, grabbing the Ex Bomb and Arrows.

subject: Muck hidden item
text: A Power Potion is hidden two steps down in the second row of muck from the left in Glasadar Cave.

evidence.quote: There is a Power Potion in the second row of the muck from the left, two steps down.

subject: First floor left room chest
text: The left room on the first floor of Glasadar Cave contains a Black Ring.

evidence.quote: Enter the left room and take the Black Ring.

subject: Second floor far left chest
text: Heading all the way left on the second floor of Glasadar Cave leads to an Antidote.

evidence.quote: Enter the right room and head to the second floor. Head all the way left and take the Antidote.

subject: Second floor ladder chest
text: A Smoke Ball is found up the long ladder, and the adjacent left room contains a Hi Potion.

evidence.quote: Go up the long ladder and take the Smoke Ball. The left room contains a Hi Potion.

subject: Second floor right room chest
text: Sonic Heels are located in the right room, and a Hi Magic is in the center room of Glasadar Cave.

evidence.quote: In the right room, take the Sonic Heels, continue on, take the Hi Magic in the center room

subject: Second floor upper right chest
text: A Stone Cure is located in the upper right corner of the second floor in Glasadar Cave.

evidence.quote: Go up in the right corner and take the Stone Cure.

subject: Upper right room chest
text: Climbing the high ladder leads to a right room holding a Great Potion.

evidence.quote: Head up, and then into the room to the right to get a Great Potion.

subject: Upper hallway right chests
text: Keeping to the right along the upper path awards a Miracle and a Gloom Arrow.

evidence.quote: Back out, keep right, taking the Miracle and Gloom Arrow.

subject: Upper hallway left chests
text: The left side of the upper hallway holds a Mind Gourd and a Dragon Arrow.

evidence.quote: On the left side, take the Mind Gourd and Dragon Arrow.

subject: Back room chests
text: The back of the upper right room contains an Ex Potion and a Big Arrow.

evidence.quote: Climb up to the right room, and go to the back of the room. (Take either door, it doesn't make a difference.) You'll find an Ex Potion and Big Arrow waiting for you.

subject: Left ladder chest
text: Climbing the upper left ladder leads to a second Ex Bomb in Glasadar Cave.

evidence.quote: Exit out, and head up the left ladder to get a second Ex Bomb.

subject: Upper path far right chest
text: Continuing all the way right past the skipped door yields a second set of Ex Arrows.

evidence.quote: continue all the way right to get a second set of Ex Arrows.

subject: Final room muck and chests
text: In the final room, one Miracle is hidden in the muck between the two pillars one step in, while two chests contain two more Miracles.

evidence.quote: Climb up the ladder and enter the final room. In the muck, there is a Miracle in between the two pillars, one step into the muck. The other two chests contain two more Miracles.

subject: First floor side rooms
text: The side rooms on the first floor of Glasadar Tower hold a Hi Potion and an Ex Bomb.

evidence.quote: Inside the tower, the rooms on the left and right contain a Hi Potion and Ex Bomb.

subject: Second floor center room
text: The second floor center room contains a Big Arrow, and the first room off the right hallway holds Ex Arrows.

evidence.quote: Enter the center room and take the Big Arrow, then head up to the hallway. Go right, and into the first room. Head down and right to get Ex Arrows.

subject: Third floor rooms
text: Heading left on the third floor yields a Hi Magic, while heading right yields a Power Gourd and Mind Gourd.

evidence.quote: Head left and get the Hi Magic. Right is a Power Gourd and Mind Gourd.

subject: Third floor hallway room
text: Heading right along the third floor hallway leads to a room with a Revive in the lower right.

evidence.quote: Head right, and then in the next room, head right and down to get a Revive.

subject: Fourth floor lower rooms
text: Passing through the small fourth floor room gives an Ex Bomb, a Gloom Arrow, and leads to a Gloom Ring and a Miracle at the end.

evidence.quote: Continue through the small room, and take the Ex Bomb. Head down and out, and then take the Gloom Arrow. Keep going down, eventually to the end, where you'll recieve a Gloom Ring and a Miracle.

subject: Fourth floor hallway room
text: Entering the room past the fourth floor upper right hallway leads down to an Antidote.

evidence.quote: Keep going into the next room, and then head down, take the Antidote, and then continue up to the fifth floor.

subject: Sixth floor switches
text: On the sixth floor of Glasadar Tower, four switches control the portal destinations, with the standalone switch resetting the other three.

evidence.quote: Up on the sixth floor are four switches. The switch alone turn the three back to normal. The three switches determine where the portal leads to.

subject: Right switch
text: Setting only the right switch on the sixth floor sends the portal to a Stun Arrow.

evidence.quote: Right: Stun Arrow. You'll have to drop down from here and go back through the castle

subject: Middle and right switches
text: Activating the middle and right switches sends the portal to a Miracle and an adjoining secret treasure room.

evidence.quote: Middle-Right: Miracle. After taking it, leave the room, but DON'T drop in the hole yet. Go through the room and you'll come across a secret room filled with treasure!

subject: Middle switch
text: Activating only the middle switch configures the portal to reach the seventh floor.

evidence.quote: Middle: Seventh Floor. Continue through the hallways, (don't fall in the hole. . .) and make your way to the seventh floor

subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby is encountered on the seventh floor of Glasadar Tower.

evidence.quote: and make your way to the seventh floor, where you will encounter Nazeby, the Sinistral who just wasn't good enough.

subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby's Spark magic deals roughly 30 damage to each character.

evidence.quote: His 'special magic attack', Spark, does friggin' 30 damage to each character. Have Lufia use Thunder if needed.

subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby rarely casts Sunder during the fight.

evidence.quote: Nazeby *rarely*, and I mean *rarely* uses Sunder, but if he does, just use your Revives.

subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby resists magic attacks but takes high physical damage from a Hero boosted with Power Gourds.

evidence.quote: Magic attacks don't do much against him, but physical attacks sure do! Use your hard-earned Power Gourds to boost up Hero to an unblockable powerhouse.

subject: Nazeby
text: Near low health Nazeby begins casting Vulcan, dealing 70-100 HP of damage.

evidence.quote: Near the end, you'll know you'll be whittling down his HP, because he'll start to use Vulcan, which brings down 70-100 HP.

subject: Lufia
text: After defeating Nazeby, Lufia leaves the party taking the Dual Blade along with her.

evidence.quote: Eventually, she's gone with the Dual Blade, and you're left with three characters.

subject: Switch combination None
text: Setting none of the three switches determines that the portal leads to a Miracle.

evidence.quote: The three switches determine where the portal leads to. Here are the combinations that lead somewhere worth going to....None: Miracle.

subject: Nazeby
text: The only remotely dangerous attack Nazeby uses is Mace, which hardly ever works.

evidence.quote: The only remotely dangerous attack he uses is Mace, which is doom with a crappier name....Mace hardly ever works.
